item.title: azure: Retirement: OT security in Microsoft Defender for IoT
item.description:
Microsoft plans to deprecate the OT security component of Microsoft Defender for IoT. The service will be fully deprecated in October 2029 after a three-year transition period.

  • Source: Azure Updates
